ssh.command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -i /Users/j/Downloads/gupiao.pem ubuntu@43.143.243.97 
set -eu
LATEST="$(sudo find /home -path '/home/*/mysql-backups/*.sql.gz' -type f -printf '%s %T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -k2,2nr | head -1 || true)"
if test -z "$LATEST"; then
  echo "__NO_BACKUP__"
  exit 0
fi
SIZE="$(printf '%s\n' "$LATEST" | awk '{print $1}')"
MTIME="$(printf '%s\n' "$LATEST" | awk '{print $2}')"
PATH_VALUE="$(printf '%s\n' "$LATEST" | cut -d' ' -f3-)"
echo "__BACKUP__ $SIZE $MTIME $PATH_VALUE"
if sudo gzip -t "$PATH_VALUE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "__GZIP__ ok"
else
  echo "__GZIP__ fail"
fi
SHA="$(sudo sha256sum "$PATH_VALUE" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
echo "__SHA256__ $SHA"
echo "__SAMPLE_BEGIN__"
sudo gzip -cd "$PATH_VALUE" 2>/dev/null | head -c 65536 || true
printf '\n__SAMPLE_END__\n'
